name: priberry-vscode
displayName: Priberry: Launch Blockers, Greenlit, Crumple and Tare
description: Priberry's four free safety tools in your editor: Launch Blockers flags what would leak your users' data before you deploy, Greenlit grades your live app, Crumple checks your agent setup, and Tare shows what your AI coding agents cost. Runs on your machine.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The workspace checks (Crumple and Launch Blockers) only run in trusted workspaces.

commands.title: Add Tare and Crumple to my AI apps

priberry.tare.command.description: How to run Tare. Change it to a local path (for example `node /path/to/tarelab/bin/tare.mjs`) to skip npx.

priberry.crumple.command.description: How to run Crumple. Change it to a local path (for example `node /path/to/crumplelab/bin/crumple.mjs`) to skip npx.

priberry.greenlit.command.description: How to run Greenlit. Change it to a local path (for example `node /path/to/greenlitlab/bin/greenlit.mjs`) to skip npx.

priberry.launchBlockers.command.description: How to run Launch Blockers. Change it to a local path (for example `node /path/to/launch-blockers/bin/launch-blockers.mjs`) to skip npx.

priberry.tare.refreshMinutes.description: How often the status bar re-reads your agent logs.

priberry.crumple.scanOnOpen.description: Check the workspace's agent setup when a folder opens.

priberry.launchBlockers.checkOnOpen.description: Check the workspace for ways it could leak users' data when a folder opens.
